description: Prices and offers for an exact stay and guests at one hotel. The answer is always for the requested dates and guests, or an error with a code (e.g. CHECKIN_IN_PAST, HOTEL_NOT_OPERATING, AGE_RESTRICTION, OCCUPANCY_NOT_SUPPORTED). availability_status "available": the room can be booked on the website with a 20% deposit or requested; "on_request": high-demand nights, only a request, and a booking advisor confirms the room. The connector does not book or take payments. Each rate has a booking_url: it opens the room page on corissia.com with the dates, the board and the guests of that room, where the guest adds the room and sends the request or books, typing name, e-mail and phone; the link contains nothing personal. API v3.

board.description: Only this board: BB, HB or AI.

hotel.description: Hotel id: hiltonchania, flair, harmony, princess or beach.

lang.description: Language of names, texts and links: de or en (default en).

rooms.description: The guests, room by room (1 to 5 rooms).

adults.description: Adults in this room. The API answers OCCUPANCY_NOT_SUPPORTED when no room type takes the guests.

children_ages.description: Age of each child on the day of arrival (0-17).
